title: Ubuntu PPA missing Geth v1.17.5 stable package for Noble (24.04)
body:
#### System information

Geth version:
```
Geth
Version: 1.17.4-stable
Git Commit: 36a7dc72e96b3f42846be925cfeb2fad18489917
Architecture: amd64
Go Version: go1.25.10
Operating System: linux
```

OS:
```
Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS (Noble), amd64
```

Repository:
```
https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ethereum/ethereum/ubuntu
```

#### Expected behaviour

Geth v1.17.5 is the current stable release. The v1.17.5 release notes state that Ubuntu packages are available in the Launchpad PPA.

I would therefore expect `ppa:ethereum/ethereum` on Ubuntu 24.04 (Noble) to provide the v1.17.5 stable package.

#### Actual behaviour

The latest stable package available for Noble amd64 is still:

```
geth 1.17.4+build10975+noble
```

`apt-cache policy geth ethereum` returns:

```
geth:
  Installed: 1.17.4+build10975+noble
  Candidate: 1.17.4+build10975+noble
  Version table:
 *** 1.17.4+build10975+noble 500
        500 https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ethereum/ethereum/ubuntu noble/main amd64 Packages
        100 /var/lib/dpkg/status

ethereum:
  Installed: 1.17.4+build10975+noble
  Candidate: 1.17.4+build10975+noble
  Version table:
 *** 1.17.4+build10975+noble 500
        500 https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ethereum/ethereum/ubuntu noble/main amd64 Packages
        100 /var/lib/dpkg/status
```

At the same time, the same PPA already provides the v1.17.6 development build for Noble:

```
ethereum-unstable:
  Candidate: 1.17.6+build12864+noble

geth-unstable:
  Candidate: 1.17.6+build12864+noble
```

I also checked the PPA package index directly:

```
https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ethereum/ethereum/ubuntu/dists/noble/main/binary-amd64/Packages.gz
```

It contains:

```
Package: ethereum
Version: 1.17.4+build10975+noble

Package: ethereum-unstable
Version: 1.17.6+build12864+noble

Package: geth
Version: 1.17.4+build10975+noble

Package: geth-unstable
Version: 1.17.6+build12864+noble
```

There is no v1.17.5 stable package in the Noble amd64 package index.

#### Steps to reproduce the behaviour

On Ubuntu 24.04 Noble with `ppa:ethereum/ethereum` configured:

```
sudo apt update
apt-cache policy geth ethereum
apt-cache policy geth-unstable ethereum-unstable
apt-cache madison geth
```

`apt update` completes successfully and the PPA is reachable, but v1.17.4 remains the latest stable candidate.

Could you please check whether the v1.17.5 stable PPA publication for Ubuntu Noble was missed or failed?
